title: Cromartie High School
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Takashi Kamiyama ends up at Cromartie High, a school of delinquents where, per the ADV blurb, 'the fist rules' and the halls hold foul-mouthed robots, apes and masked villains. An episodic surreal parody of delinquent manga (AniList Surreal Comedy, Parody; MU Random Plot, Episodic). It won the 2002 Kodansha Manga Award for shonen (MU note).
life_message: Absurd humour: the posturing of tough-guy delinquent culture is played for laughs.

folkways.japan: Parodies the Japanese yankii (delinquent) genre, whose gakuran uniforms and gang honor codes were a staple of 1980s-90s shonen manga.
